additional_context: ElementDefinition is active in the current build configuration. Later same-invariant decisions, including FHIR-15133 and FHIR-14389, changed the broader allowed character set and regex shape while preserving FHIR-13771's literal underscore; both related issues are already represented on the combined branch.
